The 100th Day of School: What Teamwork Can Build! — It's the 100th day of school! The classroom challenge is to build a tower of 100 giant foam blocks before the recess bell rings!
Kids science answer for "100th day of school moral story cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

One person stacking 100 blocks alone gets tired and frustrated; when teammates share tasks, colossal castles rise effortlessly.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
